walkthrough: The block starts from rest, so initial kinetic energy is zero and final gravitational potential energy can be taken as zero at the bottom.
The vertical drop is the side opposite $\theta$ in the triangle with hypotenuse $L$, so $h = L\sin\theta$.
Conservation of mechanical energy with no resistive forces gives $mgh = \frac{1}{2}mv^2$, so mass $m$ cancels to give $v = \sqrt{2gh}$.
Since $\sqrt{19.6} = 4.427...$, this becomes $v = 4.43\sqrt{L\sin\theta}$. This is option B.
